title: Trump news at a glance: No Kings rallies draw millions to US streets in protest against president | Trump administration | The Guardian
summary: Millions participated in No Kings protests against the Trump administration, focusing on opposition to war with Iran, rising living costs, and federal immigration enforcement. Simultaneously, a significant protest occurred outside the NIH headquarters against cuts to medical research. The US treasury demanded retraction of a story on increased oversight of the Federal Reserve, and the US House passed a stopgap DHS funding bill after rejecting a Senate deal.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is negative due to the focus on protests against government policies and actions, such as war, immigration enforcement, and budget standoffs affecting essential services.
